codeReview.summary: Feature adds the requested packager, checksum verifier, tests, and service commands, but two blocking integrity gaps remain: required raw artifacts are not enforced as required, and checksum verification can be bypassed by dropping checksum entries from publication_manifest.json.

issues.description: Missing files from REQUIRED_RAW_ARTIFACTS only emit a warning and packaging continues. This can produce a publication bundle that omits required raw artifacts while still reporting success, violating expected behavior that publication manifests include required artifacts.

Verifier trusts publication_manifest.checksums as the full verification set and does not validate checksum coverage against manifest artifacts/required artifacts. A tampered manifest with removed checksum entries can still return gate=pass, so integrity verification is incomplete.

sharedStateObservations.observation: benchmark-worker SKILL step 7 requires publication manifest completeness verification, but the procedure does not explicitly require negative tests for missing required artifacts or checksum-map coverage tampering.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: .factory/skills/benchmark-worker/SKILL.md (Work Procedure step 7) and benchmarks/tests/test_publication_artifacts.py (no failing-path test for missing REQUIRED_RAW_ARTIFACTS; no test for removed checksum entries in publication_manifest.json).
